Bidder shall elect, per tie-in point, method (a) temporary over-pumping or (b) interruption within the permitted shutdown window in Table 1-3, and state the election in the construction methodology section of the Technical Proposal.
If method (b) is elected: Shutdown Acceptance Letter from the Network Operator with Envelope A; application not later than eight (8) Working Days before the Proposal Due Date.
Method (b) without a Shutdown Acceptance Letter in Envelope A is deemed an election of method (a) for that tie-in point.
A Proposal providing for an interruption of flow longer than the maximum shutdown duration in Table 1-3 for that tie-in point shall be rejected.
